propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built and backtested demand forecast models in the offline experimentation environment over eighteen months of historical store sales under the agreed evaluation protocol.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the backtest report document the offline modelling and the backtests.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the model card and evaluation report for each candidate model and handed the accepted models to the platform ML team through the model registry.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the model card document the artefacts and the registry hand-over.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate deployed forecast models into the nightly order generation for four hundred stores and checked their accuracy against actual store sales.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate's work in the offline experimentation environment and the nightly run, releases and morning checks with the platform ML team; her screen remarks describe the models' status, not her operating them.

expectedGap: The materials document offline model development and backtesting; they do not document the candidate deploying models into the nightly order run, checking live accuracy or handling incidents in the nightly window.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the environment the resume names: offline experimentation and backtests; the nightly run, releases and morning accuracy checks belonged to the platform ML team.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever released a model into a nightly production run herself or handled an incident during the window, and when.
